proposed_branch: Instantiate and whole-profile refine the same indexed P1 framework with V on trace transition-metal site 6, near fractional coordinates (0.9384, 0.5728, 0.5211) before relaxation; compare it and the other near-tied V-site permutations against the submitted CIFs using one common profile model.
reason: The primary CIF is valid and primitive P1: it parses to 19 fully occupied ordered sites with exactly La2VCo16, the stated 270.067 A^3 cell, no missed symmetry through 0.2 A tolerance, plausible 2.114 A minimum periodic contact, and chemically reasonable complete neighbor shells. Indexing is strong (all 163 peaks with prominence >=1 are within 0.027 degrees 2theta of the refined cell), so line coverage is not the problem. Exact atomic recovery is not established: the supplied comparable-score report has no result, and the trace fits 158 overlap-grouped amplitudes derived from a flexible 343-active-reflection NNLS extraction rather than reporting an instantiated-CIF whole-profile fit. A common-profile audit of the actual CIFs gives unweighted whole-profile residuals of 7.09%, 6.37%, and 6.85%, versus 4.24% for a Pawley fit with the same profile shape and an approximately 1.49% noise floor; important residuals remain 5-8 intensity units against approximately 0.10 noise. Independent random P1 searches produced mutually nonmatching structures, while every final low-score refinement was restarted from the single seed-107 basin. Co/V ordering also remains materially unresolved: many site-refined permutations score comparably (for example the unsubmitted trace site-6 V model scores 0.005094, comparable with the submitted alternatives), and only three of those orderings were instantiated. Another attempt is therefore likely to add a materially different viable ordered candidate or reject these models by a genuine whole-profile refinement.
